title: Recording a training expense
summary: A demonstration administrative procedure for preserving the invoice, purpose, currency and internal approval of training expenditure.
contentNotice: Demonstration content for Atlas interface development; not final MOSCATELLI policy.

blocks.text: Preserve the supplier, purpose, amount, currency, invoice or receipt, date and any internal approval reference required by the eventual finance process.

items: Internal approval or budget context where applicable

blocks.text: Record the original transaction currency. If an internal report later requires conversion, the converted amount should not erase the source value or the basis used.

blocks.label: Demonstration only
blocks.text: The exact accounting and tax treatment will be defined with professional advice and production finance procedures. This article currently validates the Atlas information structure only.
A short purpose note helps distinguish role-related development from other expenditure and makes later review of training investment more meaningful.
